subtitle.zh: 从单机服务到缓存与调度实验
subtitle.en: From a local server to caching and scheduling experiments

description.zh: 用同一个可复现服务贯穿十天：接口、负载、前缀缓存、调度、量化、HiCache 和 PD 分离。最终交付一份解释性能取舍的工程作品。
description.en: Follow one reproducible service through APIs, workload design, prefix reuse, scheduling, quantization, HiCache and disaggregation. Finish with an engineering portfolio that explains trade-offs.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；安装、模型下载和真机排障另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours/day, excluding setup, model downloads and hardware troubleshooting

prerequisites.zh: Python、Linux、HTTP；完成推理基础路线，理解 prefill/decode 和 KV cache。
prerequisites.en: Python, Linux and HTTP; complete inference foundations and understand prefill/decode and KV cache.

hardware.zh: 基础分析可用 CPU；真实服务测试需适配设备与可装入的小模型；PD 扩展通常需至少两张兼容 GPU。
hardware.en: CPU for analysis; compatible hardware and a fitting small model for real serving. PD extensions typically need at least two compatible GPUs.

zh: 推理工程师
性能工程师
推理 SRE
en: Inference engineer
Performance engineer
Inference SRE

outcome.zh: 可复现服务 + 负载与缓存实验 + 性能取舍报告
outcome.en: A reproducible service, workload/cache experiments and a performance trade-off report

title.zh: 建立引擎地图与版本清单
title.en: Map the engine and pin the environment

lesson.zh: 服务启动成功只证明进程能运行，还没有证明模型、API 和设备配置正确。先把一个请求拆成接收、tokenize、排队、prefill、decode 和输出六段，再标出调度器、KV cache 与执行后端负责的部分。SGLang 的功能覆盖依赖模型和硬件组合；滚动文档中的示例不是你本机的兼容性证明。建立版本清单，是之后每个性能结论能被复现的前提。
lesson.en: A running process is only the beginning of a working inference service. Separate request handling, tokenization, queueing, prefill, decode and response delivery, then identify which component owns each stage. Feature availability depends on the chosen model, device and execution backend. A command in rolling documentation does not validate your particular combination. A pinned environment manifest lets someone reproduce your result and helps distinguish a model issue from a runtime or configuration issue.

task.zh: 建立课程仓库，记录 SGLang release/commit、Python、运行时、设备、模型 revision 与使用许可。画一张请求生命周期图，给每个阶段标注输入、输出和可能等待的位置。
task.en: Create a course repository with framework release/commit, Python, runtime, device and model revision. Record model-use permissions. Draw the request lifecycle with inputs, outputs and possible waits.

evidence.zh: environment.md、请求流程图，以及三个待验证的性能问题。
evidence.en: An environment manifest, a request-flow diagram and three testable performance questions.

zh: 版本清单包含模型 revision，不能只写 latest。
能解释排队时间与模型执行时间的区别。
en: The manifest records a model revision rather than only latest.
Explain queueing time separately from model execution.

noGpu.zh: 用官方源码与文档完成地图；设备栏写“未运行”，列出计划使用的兼容硬件和模型内存预算。
noGpu.en: Build the map from source and docs. Mark execution as not run and record a compatible hardware plan and model-memory budget.

title.zh: 运行最小服务并验证协议
title.en: Serve a model and test the API

lesson.zh: 先建立简单可信的基线，再开启优化。选择能放入设备的小模型，用固定输入检查普通请求、流式响应和错误响应。输出看起来合理不等于接口正确：还要检查模型名、结束原因、token 统计及客户端超时。流式数据可能把多个 token 合并到一个网络片段，因此不能直接把每个接收片段当作一个 token 来测量解码速度。
lesson.en: Start with a small, reproducible baseline before enabling optimizations. Test a normal request, streaming and error handling using fixed inputs. A plausible answer does not establish protocol correctness: model names, finish reasons, usage information and client timeouts also matter. Network chunks can contain several tokens, so timing each received chunk is not automatically a valid inter-token-latency measurement. Keep client-side observation separate from metrics reported by the engine.

task.zh: 按所选版本官方指南启动服务，仅在本机实验入口发送五类请求：普通、流式、空输入、超长输入、主动取消。记录返回状态与资源是否释放。
task.en: Follow the guide for your pinned release. Send normal, streaming, empty, oversized and cancelled requests to your local test endpoint. Record statuses and whether resources are released.

evidence.zh: 最小启动配置、脱敏请求样例、五类请求的接口记录。
evidence.en: A minimal launch configuration, sanitized requests and an API behavior table.

zh: 至少一次普通请求和一次流式请求可重现。
错误请求有明确结果，取消后没有无限等待。
en: Reproduce one normal and one streaming request.
Invalid and cancelled requests have bounded, documented outcomes.

noGpu.zh: 编写请求和预期响应契约，用 Python 标准库建立只返回固定内容的本地模拟服务；明确它不能验证模型计算。
noGpu.en: Write API contracts and a local fixed-response server with the Python standard library. Label it as a protocol exercise, not inference validation.

title.zh: 设计能比较的负载与指标

lesson.zh: 吞吐需要说明是请求数还是输出 token 数，TTFT 则包含用户等待首个 token 的时间。固定并发的闭环客户端会在慢响应时自动降低到达率；固定请求率的开环负载更容易暴露排队压力。二者回答不同问题，不能混在同一条曲线上。还要固定输入输出长度、重复前缀比例、预热方式和失败统计，避免只保留最快的一次。
lesson.en: Throughput needs a unit: requests per second and output tokens per second are different quantities. TTFT measures a user's wait for the first token. A closed-loop client with fixed concurrency reduces offered load when responses slow down, while an open-loop arrival process exposes queue growth. These workloads answer different questions. Keep prompt/output lengths, shared-prefix ratio, warm-up and failed-request accounting explicit, and report repeated measurements instead of selecting the fastest run.

task.zh: 构造短问答与长输入两组负载。分别运行三档并发或请求率，每组至少重复三次，导出原始记录并绘制 TTFT p50/p95、吞吐和失败率。
task.en: Create short-question and long-input workloads. Sweep three concurrency or arrival-rate settings, repeat each at least three times, and export raw TTFT p50/p95, throughput and error rates.

evidence.zh: 负载生成器、原始 JSONL/CSV、指标定义与基线图表。
evidence.en: A workload generator, raw JSONL/CSV, metric definitions and baseline plots.

zh: 图表包含单位、样本数、预热和失败处理规则。
不同配置使用相同请求集合与输出长度约束。
en: Plots report units, sample counts, warm-up and error handling.
Compared configurations use the same request set and output-length constraints.

noGpu.zh: 生成带固定随机种子的到达时间与长度分布，再用明确标记的合成延迟练习统计；不得将图表标为 SGLang 性能。
noGpu.en: Generate seeded arrival and length distributions, then practice statistics on explicitly synthetic latency. Do not label those plots as SGLang performance.

title.zh: 理解 token 前缀与缓存淘汰

lesson.zh: 前缀复用依赖 token 序列及相关计算状态，而不只是人眼看到的相同文字。聊天模板、系统提示或开头一个字符的变化，都可能改变可重用的最长前缀。缓存容量有限，保留热门前缀也有机会成本：为一个长前缀保留的空间可能挤出多个短会话。比较策略时，需要同时观察命中 token 数、占用和端到端延迟。
lesson.en: Prefix reuse concerns token sequences and compatible computation state, not just visually similar text. Chat templates or a change near the beginning can alter the reusable prefix. Finite cache capacity also creates opportunity costs: one long prefix may displace several shorter sessions. A useful experiment measures reusable tokens, memory pressure and end-to-end latency together. Treat a small prefix simulator as an explanation of the mechanism rather than a faithful replacement for the engine's radix-cache implementation.

task.zh: 准备完全共享、部分共享、不共享三组提示。固定其他变量，分别从冷缓存和热缓存开始测试；再在固定容量下加入新前缀，观察命中变化。
task.en: Prepare fully shared, partially shared and unrelated prefixes. Test cold and warm states while holding other variables fixed, then add new prefixes under a fixed capacity and observe changes.

evidence.zh: token 前缀对照表、冷热实验记录与淘汰现象说明。
evidence.en: A token-prefix comparison, cold/warm records and an explanation of eviction behavior.

zh: 能指出文本相似但 token 前缀不同的例子。
说明如何重置缓存，避免把预热当作命中收益。
en: Show text similarity that does not preserve the token prefix.
Document cache reset and distinguish warm-up from cache reuse.

noGpu.zh: 用整数 token 列表实现最长公共前缀和容量受限的 LRU，手工追踪一组访问序列；标注这是教学模型。
noGpu.en: Implement longest-common-prefix and bounded LRU over integer token lists. Trace an access sequence and label it an educational model.

caption.zh: CPU 教学示例：整数代表 token id，不模拟实际缓存吞吐。
caption.en: CPU teaching example: integers represent token IDs; this is not a cache-performance model.

title.zh: 调度、分块 prefill 与显存预算

lesson.zh: 长 prompt 的 prefill 与逐步生成的 decode 会争用计算和显存。让更多请求进入批次可能增加吞吐，也可能拉长尾延迟；分块 prefill 把大任务拆小，但新增的调度与重复开销也需要测量。显存预算必须同时考虑模型权重、KV cache、临时张量和运行时保留量。调参时先固定负载，每次只改变一个因素。
lesson.en: Long-prompt prefill and token-by-token decode compete for compute and memory. Larger active batches may improve throughput while worsening tail latency. Chunking prefill changes how work is interleaved, but its scheduling overhead and workload dependence still need measurement. Budget memory for weights, KV state, temporary tensors and runtime reservations. Change one factor at a time on a fixed workload so a throughput gain can be connected to its latency and memory costs.

task.zh: 选一个与你的版本匹配的调度或容量参数，测试三个设置。加入长短混合请求，记录吞吐、TTFT、输出 token 延迟、显存与失败；不要同时切换多个开关。
task.en: Choose one scheduling or capacity parameter documented for your release and test three settings. Use a mixed-length workload and record throughput, TTFT, token latency, memory and failures.

evidence.zh: 单变量实验表、显存预算、一次参数取舍说明。
evidence.en: A single-variable experiment, a memory budget and one justified configuration trade-off.

zh: 所有比较仅改变一个参数。
结论包含尾延迟或资源成本，不能只报告吞吐。
en: Only one parameter changes in each comparison.
Report tail latency or resource costs alongside throughput.

noGpu.zh: 用离散事件表模拟长短作业交错，对比分块与不分块的等待时间；写清楚没有模拟 GPU 内核和真实调度器。
noGpu.en: Use a discrete-event table to compare chunked and unchunked long/short jobs. Explicitly exclude GPU kernels and real scheduler behavior from the model.

title.zh: 量化要同时检查精度与性能

lesson.zh: 减少位宽可以降低部分内存流量，但未必让所有设备和形状更快。权重量化、激活量化与 KV cache 量化改变的是不同对象，支持的后端也可能不同。比较时要确认使用同一个模型来源、模板、任务与输出约束。把错误率和质量回归与时延并列呈现，比只展示更小的文件或更快的某次请求更有价值。
lesson.en: Lower precision can reduce memory traffic, but acceleration depends on hardware, shapes and supported kernels. Weight, activation and KV-cache quantization change different objects and may require different backends. Comparisons need consistent model provenance, templates, tasks and output constraints. Pair latency and memory results with correctness or quality regression checks. A smaller artifact or one fast response is insufficient evidence that the chosen quantization is appropriate for the intended workload.

task.zh: 选择官方明确支持的一种精度对照，准备至少十个可检查结果的测试输入。先做正确性检查，再测相同负载的延迟与显存；记录不支持的组合。
task.en: Select one officially supported precision comparison. Prepare at least ten checkable inputs, validate correctness first, then measure latency and memory on the same workload. Record unsupported combinations.

evidence.zh: 精度/质量检查表、性能对比、支持条件与回退建议。
evidence.en: A correctness/quality table, performance comparison, support conditions and rollback recommendation.

zh: 明确被量化的是权重、激活还是 KV。
失败或质量下降样例保留在报告中。
en: Identify whether weights, activations or KV state are quantized.
Keep failures and quality-regression examples in the report.

noGpu.zh: 写一个标量量化与反量化脚本，观察缩放因子、舍入和饱和误差；完成实机评测计划，不推断模型质量。
noGpu.en: Implement scalar quantization/dequantization to inspect scaling, rounding and saturation. Prepare a hardware evaluation plan without inferring model quality.

title.zh: 从 GPU 缓存到 HiCache 分层

lesson.zh: 把缓存移出 GPU 可以扩大可保留状态的容量，但重新使用前仍需支付查找和数据移动的代价。GPU、主机内存和外部存储具有不同延迟与带宽，层级更多不自动意味着服务更快。真正的比较应让数据分别命中不同层，记录读取量与用户可感知的延迟，并控制引擎本地缓存，避免把 GPU 命中误判为外部层收益。
lesson.en: Moving cache state outside GPU memory expands potential reuse capacity, but lookup and transfer still cost time. GPU memory, host memory and external storage have different latency and bandwidth characteristics. Additional tiers do not automatically improve serving. Construct requests that deliberately hit different tiers and connect transferred bytes to user-visible latency. Control the engine's local state so a GPU hit cannot be mistaken for evidence that an external storage tier helped.

task.zh: 阅读 HiCache 及对应存储适配器文档，画出三层数据路径。选一种支持的层级配置测试容量压力；若连接 Mooncake，记录每个组件版本与数据来源。
task.en: Map HiCache tiers and the chosen storage adapter. Test capacity pressure with one supported configuration. If using Mooncake, record every component version and identify the source of reused data.

evidence.zh: 分层图、每层容量/延迟预算，以及至少一个层级切换案例。
evidence.en: A tier diagram, per-tier capacity/latency budget and one tier-transition case.

zh: 能区分本地命中、主机命中和外部读取。
报告同时包含容量收益与读取开销。
en: Distinguish local hits, host hits and external retrieval.
Report capacity benefits together with retrieval cost.

noGpu.zh: 根据给定的合成带宽/延迟参数绘制重计算与读取的盈亏边界，明确参数不是设备实测值。
noGpu.en: Plot a recompute-versus-retrieve boundary using explicitly synthetic bandwidth and latency inputs, not measured device performance.

title.zh: 判断何时值得做 PD 分离

lesson.zh: PD 分离把 prefill 和 decode 放到不同资源池，目的是让不同工作更独立地调度与扩展。代价是传输 KV、额外排队、配置复杂度与失效路径。短输入或网络较慢时，转移状态的成本可能抵消收益。评估要保持相同模型、总设备预算和负载，观察首 token、输出节奏和失败率，而不是仅比较两个系统的峰值吞吐。
lesson.en: Prefill/decode disaggregation places different phases in separate resource pools so they can be scheduled and scaled independently. The trade-off includes KV transfer, extra queues, configuration complexity and failure paths. Short prompts or slow links can erase the expected benefit. Compare equivalent model, total device budget and workloads, and observe TTFT, output cadence and failures. Peak throughput from unequal hardware is not evidence that disaggregation improves a deployment.

task.zh: 根据官方支持路径设计一个最小 PD 拓扑，标出路由、prefill、decode、传输和侧信道端口。有硬件时与聚合基线对照；先确认输出正确，再增加负载。
task.en: Design a minimal supported PD topology with router, prefill, decode, transfer and side-channel ports. With hardware, compare against an aggregated baseline, verifying correctness before increasing load.

evidence.zh: 拓扑与端口表、传输预算、聚合/分离对照或明确标注的实验计划。
evidence.en: A topology, port map, transfer budget and an aggregated/disaggregated comparison or labeled test plan.

zh: 写明总 GPU 数、网络和模型版本，比较条件对齐。
给出一个不建议采用 PD 的负载场景。
en: State total GPUs, network and model versions with matched comparison conditions.
Describe one workload where PD is not recommended.

noGpu.zh: 用 KV 字节数/有效带宽加固定开销估算传输下界，与假设的 prefill 收益对比；给出敏感性分析。
noGpu.en: Estimate transfer lower bounds from KV bytes, effective bandwidth and fixed overhead, then compare with hypothetical prefill savings and vary the assumptions.

title.zh: 把指标、错误与恢复连起来

lesson.zh: 单个平均值很难解释用户经历。请求延迟、排队、缓存命中、资源占用与错误要在同一时间线上观察；计数器重启后可能重置，直方图的分桶也限制分位数精度。日志中的 prompt 可能包含隐私，练习使用合成输入即可。故障实验的目标是明确结果和恢复边界，不是让所有错误都被重试隐藏。
lesson.en: Averages rarely explain an individual user's experience. Correlate latency, queue depth, reuse, resource use and errors over the same timeline. Counters may reset on restart, and histogram buckets affect percentile estimates. Synthetic prompts are enough for this exercise and avoid exposing private request content. A failure experiment should reveal outcomes and recovery boundaries rather than hide every problem behind retries. Track unfinished work and resources as well as visible responses.

task.zh: 启用所选版本的指标，记录正常、过载和受控重启三段时间线。对每段写一个现象、假设、证据链；检查客户端取消后的活动请求变化。
task.en: Enable metrics for your release and capture normal, overloaded and controlled-restart periods. Write an observation, hypothesis and evidence chain for each, including active-request behavior after cancellation.

evidence.zh: 脱敏指标样例、时间线与三条可操作的排障建议。
evidence.en: Sanitized metric samples, a timeline and three actionable troubleshooting notes.

zh: 每条结论能指向原始指标或日志。
区分客户端错误、服务错误与实验未完成。
en: Link conclusions to raw metrics or logs.
Distinguish client errors, server errors and incomplete experiments.

noGpu.zh: 使用自己生成的模拟监控序列，识别计数器重置、突发排队和异常尾延迟；把诊断规则写成测试。
noGpu.en: Generate synthetic monitoring sequences with counter resets, queue bursts and latency tails. Express the diagnosis rules as tests.

title.zh: 交付一个可被复现的推理作品

lesson.zh: 工程作品的核心不是功能数量，而是别人能否理解问题、重现结果并判断适用边界。把十天积累收敛成一个问题，例如重复前缀负载下如何在固定显存预算内降低 TTFT。保留基线、失败实验和不支持的组合，给出有条件的建议。十天结束时应能独立解释这份作品；生产运维与更复杂模型仍需要后续实践。
lesson.en: A strong engineering portfolio lets another person understand the problem, reproduce the result and assess its limits. Narrow the previous work to one question, such as reducing TTFT for shared-prefix traffic under a fixed memory budget. Keep a baseline, failed trials and unsupported combinations, then make conditional recommendations. Completing ten days means you can explain this project independently; it does not establish mastery of every model family or production operational scenario.

task.zh: 整理 README、环境锁定、启动与测试说明、原始数据、图表和复盘。请一位同伴按文档复查；无法获得复现时，将外部复核状态写为待完成。
task.en: Package the README, pinned environment, launch/test instructions, raw data, plots and retrospective. Ask a peer to check reproducibility; if none is available, mark independent verification as pending.

evidence.zh: 一个公开或可分享的作品仓库，以及 5 分钟技术讲解提纲。
evidence.en: A shareable project repository and a five-minute technical walkthrough.

zh: 从空目录能按照说明完成实验或明确的替代任务。
区分实测、模拟、推断和待验证结论。
结论说明优化适用条件以及至少一个失败案例。
en: Instructions support reproduction from a clean directory or a clearly defined alternative task.
Separate measured, simulated, inferred and unverified claims.
State applicability conditions and at least one failed experiment.

noGpu.zh: 提交完整的模拟/设计作品，标题明确为“无 GPU 设计与分析路线”；保留真机验证清单，不能补写虚构性能。
noGpu.en: Submit the complete simulation/design portfolio labeled as a no-GPU track, with a hardware-validation checklist and no fabricated measurements.
